ruleDefinitions.name: Security Privileges Enumeration Via Whoami.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a whoami.exe executed with the /priv command line flag instructing the tool to show all current user privileges. This is often used after a privilege escalation attempt.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/priv.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-priv.*")))
